name: Tweek
description:
Tweek is a minimal weekly planner and to-do app that keeps your tasks on a simple, week-at-a-glance calendar. This connector lets Claude work directly with your Tweek account, so you can plan and organize your week in plain language.

With the Tweek connector, you can ask Claude to:
• Review your week — list upcoming tasks across your calendars and see what's on any given day.
• Add tasks — create new to-dos on the right day, including recurring tasks.
• Update and reschedule — edit task text, move tasks to another day, or mark them done.
• Clean up — remove tasks you no longer need.
• Work across calendars — access your personal and shared calendars and their color labels.

Turn a quick chat into a planned week: paste in a meeting agenda and have Claude break it into tasks, reschedule everything left unfinished to next week, or get a summary of what's ahead — all synced instantly with the Tweek apps on web, iOS, and Android.

Your data stays in your Tweek account. The connector uses secure OAuth sign-in and only accesses your tasks and calendars when you ask.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Tweek to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Tweek to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://tweek.so/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Tweek MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tweek provides these MCP tools: bulk_complete_tasks, bulk_create_tasks, bulk_delete_tasks, bulk_update_tasks, complete_task, create_task, delete_task, get_task, list_calendars, list_colors, list_tasks, and update_task.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Tweek?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Tweek in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Tweek requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Tweek is developed by Tweek. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
